title: Choose the visual world for Replants
question: The roll assigned Perth Sand, In Section. Keep it, take the pick, or re-roll.

options.label: Perth Sand, In Section
options.lineage: Geotechnical borehole logs and the Swan Coastal Plain soil profile
options.thesis: The site is the planting hole: you scroll down through the sand a rescued tree goes into.
options.viewport: A live 3D grass tree sits in a cut-away block of layered sand; drag its trunk height and the price, age and ways to get it update beside a depth scale.
options.risk: Earthy orange can read rustic if the type and log grid are set softly instead of with engineering precision.

raised.raise: The page runs as fixed stations in strict order: Choose, Get it home, Plant, The first 24 months.
One data table drives both the 3D tree and the accessible HTML price table, so neither can drift.
Every control previews its consequence before commit: the total updates while you drag, before you book.
States stamp rather than vanish: the Trailer Special's old price is struck through and stays visible.

options.label: Flagging Tape & Tree Tags
options.lineage: The marking system of a land-clearing site
options.thesis: Fluoro tape around a trunk means this one gets saved; the site is built from that tag.
options.viewport: A 3D grass tree wrapped in pink flagging tape whose tag carries its size and price, beside a booking strip.
options.risk: The most obvious read of a rescue business; strong, but closest to where most runs would land.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: The tree's recovery as a print slowly developing in the tray.
options.viewport: A developing print of a grass tree under amber light.
options.case: Fuses poorly: homeowners buying a tree don't identify with photo chemistry.
options.risk: Hides the price and the action behind a metaphor.

options.label: Jacquard Brocade
options.thesis: Each tree woven from its own instruction card.
options.viewport: A brocade grass tree emerging row by row.
options.case: Fuses poorly: luxury textile has nothing to do with WA bush.
options.kept: One data matrix drives both the render and the accessible version.
options.risk: Reads as a fashion house, not a tree rescuer.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.thesis: Edit the tree like live code.
options.viewport: A code buffer that grows a tree.
options.case: Fuses poorly: alienates an older, phone-first audience.
options.risk: Unreadable to the people who buy grass trees.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Your pick-up booked as a coupon book.
options.viewport: A tear-off coupon for a Saturday pick-up.
options.case: Fuses poorly: travel ephemera has no tie to the bush or the garden.
options.risk: Pretty but unrelated to the product.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: Pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.viewport: A raked rack of price slides.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lateral travel and one type size fight an older audience.
options.kept: Strict type discipline: very few sizes, rank by weight.
options.risk: Clever, but makes simple prices hard to read.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: Recovery as a shifting spectral band.
options.viewport: A white field with a thin spectral edge.
options.case: Fuses poorly: too cool and abstract for sun-baked sand and black trunks.
options.kept: A named state vocabulary (stressed, establishing, established, self-reliant).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean native-nursery shop, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with headline and Shop button, a row of tree-size cards below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every garden centre; the rescue story becomes a footnote.
